messages.content: "你能幫我計算三個不同三角形的總面積嗎？第一個三角形的底邊長為15公尺，高度為20公尺。第二個三角形的底邊長為25英呎，高度為30英呎。第三個三角形的底邊長為35英吋，高度為40英吋。我想要每個三角形的面積以它們各自的單位呈現。"

function.name: geometry_area_triangle
function.description: Calculate the area of a triangle. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

base.description: The length of the base of the triangle.

height.description: The height of the triangle from the base.

unit.description: The measurement unit for the area. Defaults to square meters.

message.reasoning: We need to calculate area of each triangle. Use function geometry_area_triangle. Provide base, height, unit. For first: base 15, height 20, unit default square meters. For second: base 25, height 30, unit square feet. For third: base 35, height 40, unit square inches. Then sum areas? They want total area but also each area in its own unit. Actually "我想要每個三角形的面積以它們各自的單位呈現" means they want each area in its own unit. They didn't ask for total area in a single unit. So we can provide each area. But they asked "計算三個不同三角形的總面積" which implies sum. But then they say each area in its own unit. So maybe we give each area and also sum them in a common unit? But they didn't specify a common unit. We could sum them in each unit separately? That doesn't make sense. Probably they want each area individually. So we will call function for each triangle. Then output results.
